## 1. Common Data Types

### KOLResult

Returned inside any endpoint that returns KOL data.

| Field | Type | Description | Example |
|-------|------|-------------|---------|
| `id` | `int` | Unique KOL identifier | `42` |
| `name` | `str` | KOL display name | `"KOL_42"` |
| `country` | `str` | Target market country code | `"MY"` |
| `category` | `str` | Content category | `"beauty"` |
| `followers` | `int` | Total follower count | `250000` |
| `engagement_rate` | `float` | Historical engagement rate, range 0–1 | `0.0842` |
| `fit_score` | `float` | Cultural fit score for target market, range 0–1 | `0.76` |
| `cost` | `float` | Hiring fee in USD | `1200.00` |
| `expected_gmv` | `float` | Predicted GMV = followers × engagement_rate × fit_score | `15966.40` |
| `tier` | `str` | KOL tier classification | `"Micro"` |
| `creator_score` | `float` | Composite score 0–1, see scoring formula | `0.683` |
| `reasons` | `List[str]` | Why this KOL is recommended (≥3 items) | `["High engagement rate", "Strong beauty content"]` |

> **Note:** `tier`, `creator_score`, and `reasons` are planned fields (ALG-03, ALG-04, ALG-05).  
> Until those tasks are merged, these fields may be absent. Frontend must handle missing fields gracefully.

---

### AlgorithmResult

One entry inside the `results` map of `POST /optimize`.

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `algorithm` | `str` | Algorithm display name: `"Simulated Annealing"`, `"Hill Climber"`, or `"Random Search"` |
| `selected_kols` | `List[KOLResult]` | KOLs selected by this algorithm |
| `selected_count` | `int` | Number of selected KOLs |
| `total_cost` | `float` | Total hiring cost (USD) |
| `total_gmv` | `float` | Total predicted GMV (USD) |
| `roi` | `float` | Return on investment = total_gmv / total_cost |
| `history` | `List[float]` | Best GMV at each iteration step, used for convergence chart |

---

## 2. Error Format

All error responses follow this structure:

```json
{
  "detail": "Human-readable error message"
}
```

| HTTP Status | Meaning | Example Trigger |
|-------------|---------|-----------------|
| `422 Unprocessable Entity` | Invalid request body | `budget <= 0`, unknown `country` value |
| `404 Not Found` | Resource does not exist | `GET /kol/99999` where id does not exist |
| `500 Internal Server Error` | Unexpected server error | Data file missing or algorithm crash |

## 3. GET /health

Health check. Call this first to confirm the backend is running before making any other requests.

**Request:** No parameters.

**Response `200 OK`:**

```json
{
  "status": "ok"
}
```

**curl example:**

```bash
curl http://localhost:8000/health
```

## 4. POST /optimize

**The core endpoint.** Runs all three algorithms (Simulated Annealing, Hill Climber, Random Search) on the filtered KOL pool and returns a full comparison plus the best result.

### Request Body

```json
{
  "budget": 5000.0,
  "country": "MY",
  "category": "beauty",
  "seed": 42
}
```

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Validation | Description |
|-------|------|----------|---------|------------|-------------|
| `budget` | `float` | Yes | — | Must be > 0 | Total marketing budget in USD |
| `country` | `str` | No | `"MY"` | Must be one of: `MY`, `ID`, `TH`, `PH` | Target market country |
| `category` | `str` | No | `"beauty"` | Must be one of: `beauty`, `tech`, `fashion` | Product category |
| `seed` | `int` | No | `42` | 0–9999 | Random seed for reproducibility |

### Response `200 OK`

```json
{
  "budget": 5000.0,
  "country": "MY",
  "category": "beauty",
  "candidates": 18,
  "best_algorithm": "Simulated Annealing",
  "selected_kols": [
    {
      "id": 7,
      "name": "KOL_7",
      "country": "MY",
      "category": "beauty",
      "followers": 120000,
      "engagement_rate": 0.11,
      "fit_score": 0.85,
      "cost": 750.0,
      "expected_gmv": 11220.0,
      "tier": "Micro",
      "creator_score": 0.712,
      "reasons": [
        "Malaysia audience match above 80%",
        "Beauty content ratio exceeds 90%",
        "ROI 18% above category average"
      ]
    }
  ],
  "total_cost": 4780.0,
  "total_gmv": 63450.0,
  "roi": 13.27,
  "results": {
    "simulated_annealing": {
      "algorithm": "Simulated Annealing",
      "selected_kols": [ "... same KOLResult structure ..." ],
      "selected_count": 5,
      "total_cost": 4780.0,
      "total_gmv": 63450.0,
      "roi": 13.27,
      "history": [0.0, 8200.0, 21300.0, 45000.0, 63450.0]
    },
    "hill_climber": {
      "algorithm": "Hill Climber",
      "selected_kols": [ "..." ],
      "selected_count": 3,
      "total_cost": 4900.0,
      "total_gmv": 51200.0,
      "roi": 10.45,
      "history": [0.0, 35000.0, 51200.0, 51200.0, 51200.0]
    },
    "random_search": {
      "algorithm": "Random Search",
      "selected_kols": [ "..." ],
      "selected_count": 2,
      "total_cost": 3600.0,
      "total_gmv": 32100.0,
      "roi": 8.92,
      "history": [0.0, 12000.0, 28000.0, 32100.0, 32100.0]
    }
  }
}
```

| Top-level Field | Type | Description |
|-----------------|------|-------------|
| `budget` | `float` | Echo of the requested budget |
| `country` | `str` | Echo of the requested country |
| `category` | `str` | Echo of the requested category |
| `candidates` | `int` | Total KOLs in the filtered pool |
| `best_algorithm` | `str` | Name of the algorithm that achieved the highest GMV |
| `selected_kols` | `List[KOLResult]` | KOLs selected by the best algorithm |
| `total_cost` | `float` | Total cost from the best algorithm |
| `total_gmv` | `float` | Total predicted GMV from the best algorithm |
| `roi` | `float` | ROI from the best algorithm |
| `results` | `Dict[str, AlgorithmResult]` | Full results for all three algorithms |

> **Frontend note:** Use `results["simulated_annealing"].history`, `results["hill_climber"].history`, and `results["random_search"].history` to draw the convergence curve chart. All three `history` arrays are pre-truncated to the same length.

### Error Responses

| Condition | Status | `detail` message |
|-----------|--------|-----------------|
| `budget <= 0` | `422` | `"budget must be a positive number"` |
| Invalid `country` | `422` | `"country must be one of: MY, ID, TH, PH"` |
| Invalid `category` | `422` | `"category must be one of: beauty, tech, fashion"` |
| No KOLs match filters | `200` | *(returns empty result, `candidates: 0`)* |

**curl example:**

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/optimize \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"budget": 5000, "country": "MY", "category": "beauty", "seed": 42}'
```

## 5. GET /kols

Returns a filtered, paginated list of all KOLs in the database.

### Query Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| `country` | `str` | No | — | Filter by country. One of: `MY`, `ID`, `TH`, `PH` |
| `category` | `str` | No | — | Filter by category. One of: `beauty`, `tech`, `fashion` |
| `tier` | `str` | No | — | Filter by tier. One of: `Mega`, `Macro`, `Micro`, `Nano` |
| `limit` | `int` | No | `50` | Max results to return, 1–200 |
| `offset` | `int` | No | `0` | Pagination offset |

### Response `200 OK`

```json
{
  "total": 42,
  "limit": 50,
  "offset": 0,
  "kols": [
    {
      "id": 7,
      "name": "KOL_7",
      "country": "MY",
      "category": "beauty",
      "followers": 120000,
      "engagement_rate": 0.11,
      "fit_score": 0.85,
      "cost": 750.0,
      "expected_gmv": 11220.0,
      "tier": "Micro",
      "creator_score": 0.712,
      "reasons": []
    }
  ]
}
```

**curl example:**

```bash
curl "http://localhost:8000/kols?country=MY&category=beauty&tier=Micro"
```

## 6. GET /kol/{id}

Returns full details for a single KOL including all extended fields and recommendation reasons.

### Path Parameter

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `id` | `int` | KOL unique identifier |

### Response `200 OK`

```json
{
  "id": 7,
  "name": "KOL_7",
  "country": "MY",
  "category": "beauty",
  "followers": 120000,
  "engagement_rate": 0.11,
  "fit_score": 0.85,
  "cost": 750.0,
  "expected_gmv": 11220.0,
  "tier": "Micro",
  "creator_score": 0.712,
  "avg_views": 45000,
  "avg_likes": 3800,
  "gender_ratio": 0.78,
  "age_group": "18-24",
  "reasons": [
    "Malaysia audience match above 80%",
    "Beauty content ratio exceeds 90%",
    "ROI 18% above category average"
  ]
}
```

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| *(all KOLResult fields)* | — | See Section 1 |
| `avg_views` | `int` | Average video views in last 30 days |
| `avg_likes` | `int` | Average likes per video in last 30 days |
| `gender_ratio` | `float` | Female audience proportion, range 0–1 |
| `age_group` | `str` | Dominant audience age group: `"18-24"`, `"25-34"`, `"35+"` |

### Error Response

| Condition | Status | `detail` |
|-----------|--------|----------|
| ID not found | `404` | `"KOL with id 99999 not found"` |

**curl example:**

```bash
curl http://localhost:8000/kol/7
```

## 7. GET /top-kols

Returns the top 10 KOLs ranked by `creator_score` for a given country and category combination. Useful for the frontend leaderboard / quick-browse view.

### Query Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| `country` | `str` | No | — | Filter by country |
| `category` | `str` | No | — | Filter by category |

### Response `200 OK`

```json
{
  "country": "MY",
  "category": "beauty",
  "top_kols": [
    {
      "id": 7,
      "name": "KOL_7",
      "country": "MY",
      "category": "beauty",
      "followers": 120000,
      "engagement_rate": 0.11,
      "fit_score": 0.85,
      "cost": 750.0,
      "expected_gmv": 11220.0,
      "tier": "Micro",
      "creator_score": 0.712,
      "reasons": []
    }
  ]
}
```

**curl example:**

```bash
curl "http://localhost:8000/top-kols?country=MY&category=beauty"
```

## 8. POST /scalability

Runs all three algorithms on a dynamically generated KOL pool of size `n` and returns the execution time and final GMV for each. Used by the frontend Scalability Analysis tab and the experiments module.

### Request Body

```json
{
  "n": 200,
  "budget": 5000.0,
  "seed": 42
}
```

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Validation | Description |
|-------|------|----------|---------|------------|-------------|
| `n` | `int` | Yes | — | 10–500 | KOL pool size to test |
| `budget` | `float` | Yes | — | > 0 | Budget for the test run |
| `seed` | `int` | No | `42` | 0–9999 | Random seed |

### Response `200 OK`

```json
{
  "n": 200,
  "budget": 5000.0,
  "simulated_annealing": {
    "time_seconds": 2.34,
    "total_gmv": 48200.0,
    "roi": 10.15,
    "selected_count": 6
  },
  "hill_climber": {
    "time_seconds": 0.81,
    "total_gmv": 41300.0,
    "roi": 8.63,
    "selected_count": 4
  },
  "random_search": {
    "time_seconds": 0.52,
    "total_gmv": 27800.0,
    "roi": 5.96,
    "selected_count": 3
  }
}
```

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `n` | `int` | Echo of the requested pool size |
| `budget` | `float` | Echo of the requested budget |
| `simulated_annealing` | `ScalabilityEntry` | SA result |
| `hill_climber` | `ScalabilityEntry` | HC result |
| `random_search` | `ScalabilityEntry` | RS result |

**ScalabilityEntry fields:**

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `time_seconds` | `float` | Wall-clock execution time in seconds |
| `total_gmv` | `float` | Final best GMV found |
| `roi` | `float` | ROI of the selected portfolio |
| `selected_count` | `int` | Number of KOLs selected |

### Error Responses

| Condition | Status | `detail` |
|-----------|--------|----------|
| `n < 10` or `n > 500` | `422` | `"n must be between 10 and 500"` |
| `budget <= 0` | `422` | `"budget must be a positive number"` |

**curl example:**

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/scalability \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"n": 200, "budget": 5000, "seed": 42}'
```

---

## 9. Enum Reference

### country

| Value | Market |
|-------|--------|
| `MY` | Malaysia |
| `ID` | Indonesia |
| `TH` | Thailand |
| `PH` | Philippines |

### category

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `beauty` | Beauty & personal care |
| `tech` | Consumer electronics & gadgets |
| `fashion` | Clothing, accessories & lifestyle |

### tier

Automatically computed from `followers`. Do not set this manually.

| Value | Followers Range | Market Share in Dataset |
|-------|----------------|------------------------|
| `Mega` | > 1,000,000 | ~5% |
| `Macro` | 100,000 – 1,000,000 | ~20% |
| `Micro` | 10,000 – 100,000 | ~35% |
| `Nano` | < 10,000 | ~40% |

## 10. Frontend Integration Checklist

Use this checklist before submitting a PR for any frontend change that calls an API.

- [ ] Read this file fully before writing any `requests.post()` or `requests.get()` call
- [ ] Field names copied exactly from this spec (case-sensitive)
- [ ] `budget` slider lower bound set to > 0 (never allow 0)
- [ ] `country` dropdown values: `MY`, `ID`, `TH`, `PH` (uppercase, no spaces)
- [ ] `category` dropdown values: `beauty`, `tech`, `fashion` (lowercase)
- [ ] Convergence chart reads from `results["simulated_annealing"]["history"]` etc.
- [ ] Handle `candidates == 0` case: show "No KOLs found for this filter" message
- [ ] Handle `tier` / `creator_score` / `reasons` potentially missing (until ALG tasks are merged)
- [ ] Handle network error: show `st.error("Backend unavailable. Make sure uvicorn is running.")`
- [ ] Tested locally with backend running before opening PR
